verdict.rationale: Persona Workflows run automations from triggers in the background: they can automate repetitive manual decisions, tag high-risk inquiries, run extra reports when conditions are met, and ingest third-party data. Reports can also be scheduled to run against accounts at regular intervals, and Cases supports creating automations. Missing for 10: details on the available trigger types, monitoring or run history for autonomous runs, and any independent or hands-on confirmation.
